title: Court of the World
style: world folk jazz, female lead vocal, acoustic guitar brass and percussion, 86 BPM, call and response, multilingual pickleball coaching anthem, choir, longer than 2 mins
lyrics:
[INTRO]
(spoken)
Every court is yours.
Every language. Every player.
Step on.

[VERSE 1 - English]
Step onto the court and own the space
Feet apart, ready stance, set your base
Eyes forward, watch the ball
Read the court, answer every call

[VERSE 2 - Azerbaijani transliteration]
Meydana gir ve yeri sahib cix
Ayaqlar aralik, hazir durush, bazani qur
Gozler ireli, topa bax
Meydani oxu, her cagirisha cavab ver

[VERSE 3 - Tigrinya transliteration]
Nab meda ito, botakha haz
Egrikha arhiq, qrub qewmi, meseretka gber
Aynkha qdmit, kueso tekhatatel
Meda anbib, nefsi wekef tsewait melsi hab

[CHORUS]
COURT - MEYDAN - MEDA - TOA
OWN THE SPACE - HOLD YOUR BASE
COURT OF THE WORLD - EVERY GAME
STEP ON - STAND TALL - EVERY TIME

[VERSE 4 - Lao transliteration]
Kao su san lae pen jao khong phuenthi
Thao hang kan, tha phrom, tang than
Ta song kha na, bong luuk
An san, tob thuk kan riak

[VERSE 5 - Georgian transliteration]
Sheedi moedanze da daapatrondi sivrtses
Fexi gadashale, momzadebuli poze, dayeni baza
Tvalebis win, adevne tvali bolos
Moedani itsode, dzaxili upasukhod nu datovo

[VERSE 6 - Slovenian]
Stopi na igrisce in zavlada prostor
Noge narazen, pripravljeni, postavi bazo
Oci naprej, opazuj zogo
Beri igrisce, odgovori na vsak klic

[CHORUS]
COURT - MEYDAN - MEDA - TOA
OWN THE SPACE - HOLD YOUR BASE
COURT OF THE WORLD - EVERY GAME
STEP ON - STAND TALL - EVERY TIME

[BRIDGE - spoken]
(coach voice)
Azerbaijani. Tigrinya. Lao. Georgian. Slovenian.
Every player on every court.
Own the space. Read the game.
Step on.

[FINAL CHORUS]
COURT - MEYDAN - MEDA - TOA
OWN THE SPACE - HOLD YOUR BASE
COURT OF THE WORLD - EVERY GAME
STEP ON - STAND TALL - EVERY TIME
EVERY LANGUAGE - ONE COURT
STEP ON - EVERY TIME

[OUTRO]
Every court. Every language.
Step on and play.
